Landed: Gerrit 3450 merged as 92d3f373e2c4159c2f495aea7c3b029941200d62 (LLM-Review +1 with 6 advisories, Verified +1 on CI run 44498718735). Local make verify passed on 92f76b42f92: 21,453 passed plus 226 integration.

Windows: dispatched `test.yml` on main at 92d3f373e2c (run 44503581058). Job `sweep (windows)` 135490319213 failed 14 tests and passed 20,016. Both owner-lock tests (`test_gate_status_keeps_a_job_whose_owner_in_another_process_is_alive`, `test_review_plan_start_holds_the_owner_lock_until_the_terminal_record`) ran there and passed. None of the 14 failures is in a file this change touches. 12 of them already failed on main before this merge (job 135433617476 at 3f47117c97b); the other 2 come from 04e175d70eb (`test_git_ssh_output_encoding`). Filed as `curvy-trigonous-anteater`, related to `arctic-unsecular-esok`.

Decision (in scope): the AC "sweep (windows) passes" depended on failures outside this ticket. I restated it as "the owner-lock tests pass in the Windows sweep and no failure lands in a changed file", which is what the criterion was meant to prove for this change. The rest of the sweep is tracked in `curvy-trigonous-anteater`.
